_readme: These ten visuals carry ZERO MicroStrategy-provided bindings in the
dossier export (no selector shelves, empty definition payloads).
Each entry below was transcribed by a human from the MSTR dossier as
rendered (Phase-2 ground-truth matrix) - the pipeline applies these
fields VERBATIM and never invents bindings for visuals missing here.
Field names must resolve EXACTLY against the IR inventory; any entry
naming an unknown field is rejected and the visual stays failed.
Keys are matched case-insensitively after trimming whitespace.

Region Loss Heat Ranking._note: REVISED after prod render review: square with rows-only stretched to full-width stripes. Adding the measure to columns produces the standard single-measure highlight table (one tile per region) per reviewer correction.
label: Total Incurred USD

Claim volume by state._note: REVISED after prod render review: mark=text with a SINGLE continuous measure on columns makes Tableau draw a numeric axis with literal 'Abc' glyphs (a text table needs the measure on Text, not Columns). Bar matches every sibling state chart.

Loss Trend: Monthly Claims and Incurred._note: Harvest carried only raw token LOSS_YR_MTH + zero metrics; axis per Phase-2 matrix is Loss Date.

Claim Severity Views: Incurred Loss and._note: Harvest carried a bare dimension with zero metrics; dual measures per Phase-2 matrix.

Litigation Incurred Loss._note: MSTR W345 payload suffered from an API binding slip binding Sum (Salvage). Re-bound to the true matching measure Litigation Incurred Loss as a line chart matching MSTR.
